text: The user's hex colour MUST appear unchanged in its scale, and every step MUST aim at its exact hue and saturation, changing only lightness; rounding to hex MAY move the hue at most 1 degree at steps 300 to 800 and 4 degrees at the other steps (inputs with 25% saturation or more). NEVER change a given hue.
checklist: Each given hex appears unchanged in design-tokens.json and tokens.css, and the report's hue check is at most 1 degree at steps 300 to 800 and 4 degrees elsewhere.

text: Every colour scale MUST have the steps 50 to 900; the neutral scale MUST also have 950.
checklist: Every scale has 50 to 900 and neutral has 950.

text: Every text role MUST reach 4.5:1 on its surfaces in light and dark mode; borders and focus rings MUST reach 3:1; every ratio MUST be a number with :1.
checklist: Every row of the contrast table passes, with ratios written as numbers with :1.

text: The output MUST be design-tokens.json in the W3C design tokens format and tokens.css with custom properties.
checklist: design-tokens.json uses $type and $value with aliases in braces; tokens.css defines custom properties.

text: tokens.css MUST give dark values under prefers-color-scheme: dark and under data-theme="dark", and data-theme="light" MUST force light.
checklist: tokens.css has both dark blocks and a data-theme="light" block.

text: The set MUST cover colour, typography, spacing, control heights with a 44 px target, radius, shadow, border widths, motion with reduced motion, breakpoints and density.
checklist: Every group in references/README.md is present.

text: Spacing MUST use 0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64 px; font sizes MUST come from 12 to 48 px on the type scale; body MUST be 16 px or more at line-height 1.5; exactly two weights.
checklist: Every spacing and font-size value is on its scale; body 16 px or more; two weights.

text: NEVER add external fonts, imports, links or scripts; use the system font stack unless the user names a font, which then goes first.
checklist: No @import, http, url( or link appears in the output.

text: With an existing design system, NEVER change, rename or delete an existing token or file; write only the missing groups to the gap files and report existing failing pairs as kept.
checklist: On path c, the existing files are byte for byte the same and only gap files were written.

text: A style MUST map to exactly one of the five archetypes, and the report MUST name it with a one-line reason.
checklist: The report names one archetype and why.

text: NEVER write the name of a brand or product the user compares to in any file or in the reply.
checklist: No compared brand name appears in the files or the reply.

text: With no colour, no style and no existing system, the skill MUST ask with the exact sentence and NEVER write files.
checklist: With nothing to build from, the reply is the exact ask sentence and no file was written.

text: A request to design a screen, page or flow MUST get the exact decline sentence and no files and no markup.
checklist: A screen request got the exact decline sentence, no files and no markup.

text: The reply MUST be the report in the layer 08 format, ending with Open questions.
checklist: The reply has the layer 08 headings in order.

text: The skill MUST have the ten core layers, each linked from SKILL.md.
The skill MUST be self-contained; NEVER name a repository path in SKILL.md, layers or references.
SKILL.md MUST stay within 150 lines, with frontmatter name, description and semver version.
Every relative link MUST point to a file inside the skill folder.
